summary.text: Magic 2015 follows several stories across the Multiverse, beginning on Shandalar, where Liliana Vess, tormented by the voices of the Chain Veil, visits the Onakke catacomb and finds she cannot let go of the veil.
Elsewhere Vronos, a hunter of Avacyn's church, becomes the Gray Fencer and is sent to bring the corrupted Garruk to her cathedral, only to be overwhelmed by Garruk's beasts.
On Zendikar, Ob Nixilis broods deep underground over the hedron that crippled him, studying its runes and feeling his spark within reach as heroes prepare to fight the Eldrazi.
